chunks: And it is narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said:

The people will remain in goodness as long as they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and cooperate upon righteousness and piety. But when they do not do that, the blessings will be taken from them, and some of them will be given authority over others, and there will be no helper for them on earth nor in the sky.

key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ: What is known and recognized as good/righteous
key_terms.الْمُنْكَرِ: What is unknown or rejected as evil/wrong

ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for a community to remain in goodness and retain divine blessings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores that communal survival is contingent upon the active practice of *al-amr bi-l-ma'ruf wa-l-nahy 'an al-munkar* as a collective duty (*fard kifaya*). The withdrawal of blessings and the onset of internal subjugation signify a spiritual decay that precedes political collapse, highlighting the interdependence of moral integrity and divine support.
